hypothesis: CPU chip/slow RAM grant timing crossing line-end refresh causes the TST/Copper mismatch.
competitor: Instruction operand/prefetch or exception sequencing causes the mismatch independently of operand memory.
test: Cross TST/MOVE/CMP chip/ROM/slow operands with no/four/six-plane/six+Copper DMA, retaining STOP and masked read controls.

outcomes.chip/slow reads differ, ROM matches: Inspect arbitration/grant boundaries; use MOVE/CMP to test generalization beyond TST.
outcomes.TST differs across all memories while MO: Inspect instruction poll/prefetch/exception ordering before changing bus grants.
outcomes.controls all differ or alignment does no: Reject targeted bus fix; narrow launch and request timing first.

next_question: Does the first divergent memory access depend on chip-bus arbitration or instruction semantics?
